Only receiver-position loans are analyzer-visible in this increment: the two-loan containment direction, the loan acquisition and release sentences, and the exclusions have no distinct analyzer surface, and the runtime, unwinding, suspension, and task or channel affinity cuts are owned by the resource, stop, and task or channel issues.

Struct and tuple patterns, rest patterns, and pattern guards are not admitted by the v1 grammar, and the unwind, cancellation, and suspension duties of a commit are owned by the resource, stop, and wait issues, so this clause has no distinct analyzer surface in this increment.

The exclusions name contracts the other items of this section own: argument loans, task or channel transfer, resources, and the unwind, cancellation, and suspension duties. This increment claims no analyzer evidence for them.
Moving a captured owned value into a child task and channel transfer are not admitted by this increment, so the clause has no analyzer surface.
